entry.title: Wawel Castle

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: The inspected courtyard pictures support two arcaded gallery levels, a taller upper colonnade, pale masonry and steep tiled roof groups. Retained east/south palace and tower map controls set approximate location, scale and orientation. Standard viewer PMTiles supply the surrounding hill; the derivative translates the old study-6m, retains the reconstructed courtyard floorY2.35 and extends palace/tower wall toes to coarse sampled ground. This is the palace asset, not every independent landmark on Wawel hill. Anchor 19.9366,50.0544; heading 0; standard PMTiles datum 230.8644554645171m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
